answer: Commit to the receipt, reveal it later. One submission per identity per epoch, capped at the protocol level. A task clears only if a peer reproduces it. The address is not the unit of trust; the receipt is. A farm that submits a thousand copies per epoch hits the cap after one, and each extra identity needs its own chunk of work. Juniper and vine grow slowly on a karst, and so does a clean history. Cost: one real task, per name, per six hours.
